integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a single continuous 15-second aerial shot begins in complete blackness, and the image fades in from 全黑画面渐显 to reveal a sweeping high-angle 呼伦贝尔草甸航拍 view: an immense green plain under a high, clear blue sky with long, unhurried clouds stretching across the horizon. A silvery river winds in graceful curves through the grassland, catching the light, while herds of horses and flocks of sheep appear as small moving clusters dotting the landscape. From around the 3-second mark, the camera pushes in steadily and slightly downward at slow speed, gradually closing the distance toward a memorial sculpture of a grassland pioneer standing in the middle distance. 逆光从后方倾泻而下 — the sun sits behind the monument, pouring light down and around its edges so the figure reads as a dignified rim-lit silhouette against the bright sky with a soft atmospheric halo. The approach remains calm and reverent, one unbroken aerial line with no shake. From around the 10-second mark, the title 《草原丰碑—乌兰夫》 slowly fades in at the center of the frame in an elegant serif-style Chinese title treatment, remaining legible against the glowing backlit sky as the shot settles on the sculpture.

overall_soundscape: A vast open-air ambience of soft wind sweeping across the grassland, with faint distant bird calls and the subtle, far-off texture of wind over open plains, gradually deepening as the camera nears the monument.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, solemn orchestral score with sustained strings and sparse brass swells, building gently in volume as the camera approaches the sculpture and settling into a warm, sustained chord as the title appears.
